title: Person: Fleming
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Fleming

anchor.prefix:
home and lay his head on his mother’s lap. But he could not: and so he longed for the play and study and prayers to be over and to be in bed.

 He drank another cup of hot tea and
anchor.suffix:
said:

 —What’s up? Have you a pain or what’s up with you?

 —I don’t know, Stephen said.

 —Sick in your breadbasket, Fleming said, because your face looks white. It will go away
